request.description: Question sets, newest first, each with its active version (the published version currently in effect), the open draft if any and recent version summaries. Filter by `status`; paginate with `cursor`. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).

response.name: 200 OK
